verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitCafe's own native issues (labels, milestones) and a GitHub sync that imports and mirrors issues into GitCafe. There is no documented integration with an external issue tracker such as Jira or Linear, no viewing or managing of external tickets inside GitCafe, and no way to open external tickets from pull requests. GitHub sync is forge-to-forge mirroring into native issues, an adjacent feature rather than this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view and manage tickets from an external issue tracker inside the code host and open them from pull requests
